zh.title: 颱風杜鵑逼近 華航星宇虎航調整21日往返東京航班
zh.summary: 因應杜鵑颱風影響，華航、星宇與虎航調整2026年9月21日往返東京航班。
body: 受到颱風杜鵑影響，台灣多家國籍航空宣布調整2026年9月21日往返日本東京的航班。中央氣象署表示，颱風目前位於日本南方海面並朝偏東北方移動，預計21日午後至22日上半天對關東地區影響最為顯著。
台灣虎航宣布21日IT201（東京成田飛往桃園）及IT280（高雄飛往東京成田）航班提前。星宇航空21日JX314（台中飛往東京）提前至上午7時15分起飛並更改航班號為JX3314，JX315（東京飛往台中）提前至中午12時45分起飛。
中華航空則調整21日CI126與CI127（高雄往返東京成田）、CI108與CI109（桃園往返東京成田）航班提前；而CI222（松山往返東京羽田）與CI106（桃園飛往東京成田）航班則延後。長榮航空截至20日晚間7時並未宣布航班異動。

en.title: Typhoon Dujuan Forces Taiwanese Airlines to Adjust Sept 21 Tokyo Flight Schedules
en.summary: Taiwanese airlines adjusted their September 21 flight schedules to Tokyo due to Typhoon Dujuan.
body: Affected by Typhoon Dujuan, Taiwanese carriers announced schedule adjustments for Tokyo flights on September 21, 2026. The Central Weather Administration noted the typhoon is moving northeastward from south of Japan, with the most significant impact on the Kanto region expected from September 21 afternoon through the first half of September 22.

Tigerair Taiwan will advance flights IT201 (Tokyo Narita to Taoyuan) and IT280 (Kaohsiung to Tokyo Narita) on September 21. Starlux Airlines will advance flight JX314 (Taichung to Tokyo) to 7:15 a.m. as flight JX3314, and flight JX315 (Tokyo to Taichung) to 12:45 p.m.

China Airlines announced that its September 21 flights CI126/CI127 (Kaohsiung-Tokyo Narita) and CI108/CI109 (Taoyuan-Tokyo Narita) will be advanced, while flights CI222 (Songshan-Tokyo Haneda) and CI106 (Taoyuan-Tokyo Narita) are delayed. EVA Air had not announced any flight changes as of 7:00 p.m. on September 20.

zh.title: 華航總部2025年用電減27% 總座赴荷蘭交流永續營運
zh.summary: 華航總經理參訪荷蘭智慧建築；桃園總部2025年用電量較2011年降低27%
body: 為了推動環境永續發展，中華航空（華航）表示其位於桃園的總部園區，透過各項節能措施提升能源使用效率。2025年該總部園區的全年用電量較2011年園區搬遷初期降低了約27%，減少用電達454萬度，從辦公空間、修護棚廠到地面作業，積極打造兼顧營運效率與環境責任的工作場域。
此外，華航總經理陳漢銘日前走訪荷蘭阿姆斯特丹，參訪當地具代表性的智慧永續綠建築「The Edge」，亦即德勤（Deloitte）荷蘭總部所在地。華航團隊實地了解其智慧感測、能源管理、地下冷熱儲能及數位化辦公管理等運作，作為持續精進營運場域永續發展的借鏡。華航今年亦參與天合聯盟（SkyTeam）「2026 航空飛行挑戰」，執飛台北-阿姆斯特丹示範航班。

en.title: China Airlines cuts HQ electricity use by 27 percent as GM visits Netherlands
en.summary: China Airlines GM visited Amsterdam to study sustainability; HQ cut power use by 27 percent in 2025
body: China Airlines announced that its headquarters campus in Taoyuan achieved a significant reduction in energy consumption through various energy-saving measures. In 2025, the annual electricity usage of the headquarters campus decreased by approximately 27 percent compared to 2011, when the airline initially relocated to the site, representing a reduction of 4.54 million kWh.

To further exchange expertise in sustainable practices, China Airlines President Hsien-Ming Chen recently visited "The Edge" in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The renowned smart green building serves as the headquarters of Deloitte Netherlands. The visit allowed the airline's team to study its advanced energy management and smart sensing features. Additionally, China Airlines is participating in SkyTeam's "2026 Aviation Challenge," operating a demonstration flight between Taipei and Amsterdam.
